cases.description: caller-supplied known code with its own composed message is preserved, not reclassified

no error -> the whole point of the new unconditional Has Error? gate: hands back parsed JSON instead of classifying, so a caller can invoke this directly after its own agent node with no bespoke Recover State node in between

no error and no output at all (the shape a caller like context-update.json's Site-B call hands in, fed by business logic rather than a raw LLM output) -> inert, not a parse failure that matters to anything downstream
unrecognized error, non-expert -> no pre-written message for it, so it's routed to Agent: Interpret Error and the agent's own localized explanation comes back as message, never the raw error text
